title: Basel-Landschaft cyberattack: date moved to 18 November, earlier disruption added
what_changed: Date changed from 20 to 18 November: Netzwoche's report of 19 November says Alertswiss warned in the night to Wednesday 18 November that emergency numbers might be limited, with the all-clear that morning. The summary now adds that about twenty applications, including the tax calculator, were hit and six servers were being reinstalled, and gives Netzwoche's 'probably 97,000' beside SRF's 'about 97,000'. Validation changed from single_source to corroborated (SRF and Netzwoche).
